name: Ependion AB
summary: Ependion AB, together with its subsidiaries, provides digital solutions for secure control, management, visualization, and data communication for industrial applications. It operates through Beijer Electronics and Westermo segments. The Beijer Electronics segment develops and sells hard and software solutions for digitalized data control, connect, and present across a raft of sectors. The Westermo segment develops and manufactures robust network products for reliable data communication for train and trackside markets. It also offers industrial data communication. It operates in Sweden, Australia, Austria, Belgium, China, Denmark, Finland, France, Germany, India, Ireland, Korea, Netherlands, …
